definitions.explanation: The thigh — the upper part of the leg between hip and knee. Also names the thigh as a cut of meat, especially poultry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転|ころ}んで→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧もも⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}った→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: I fell and hit my thigh.
I grilled some chicken thigh meat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、もも⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: I walked for a long time, so my thigh muscles hurt.

notes:
The thigh — the upper part of the leg between hip and knee. Also names the thigh as a cut of meat, especially poultry.

WRITING:
Usually written in kana. The kanji {腿|もも} (anatomical) or {股|もも} may appear, but kana is most common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- もも{肉|にく}: thigh meat (chicken, pork)
- {内|うち}もも: inner thigh
- もも⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to raise the thigh (e.g., in exercise)
